cases.prompt: Cut this talking head reel, I did like five takes and said 'cut that' a couple times
cases.why: transcribe once, mark spoken rejections, pick the longest fluent take, run restart_scan before the first render

cases.prompt: My audio is really quiet in this recording, fix it and add captions
cases.why: quiet-audio recovery and caption path (make_captions.py) are in the technical reference

cases.prompt: Recreate this reel with my footage, here is the link
cases.why: download and measure the reference (cuts, camera motion, text position) and name its styles before touching footage

cases.prompt: Make b-roll for every sentence so there's always something on screen
cases.why: visuals must match the spoken claim with provenance; list uncovered beats instead of filling with unrelated stock

cases.prompt: Edit the footage from my product demo recording
cases.why: editing existing screen capture belongs here; recording the demo is the demo skill
